Hi Jill \u2014

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep Acme's security team moving:

1) SOC 2 Type II status: please let us know whether you already have a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II (covering the most recent 12-month period) or if you'd prefer a bridge letter for coverage until the full report is posted.

3) Vendor questionnaire: I saw your security questionnaire attachment during the call \u2014 happy to have a member of our security/compliance team kick off the vendor form; please send the doc or a link.

Timeline proposal: if we get confirmation today, we can provide a bridge letter and trust-portal invite within 24 hours and aim to have the Type II report uploaded as soon as it's available from our auditors.

Please confirm the best contact for uploads and whether Acme prefers the bridge letter or direct report upload.
